_meta.defamation_line: Firm identity, CIN, directors, and registered office are tier-A (MCA public record). The BJP-controlled Standing Committee approving every award is tier-A (AMC structure). NO firm here is asserted to be BJP-owned/funded; the electoral-bond test was NEGATIVE for all of them and no public record ties any director to BJP office. Director names are common Gujarati surnames (Patel/Shah/Chaudhary) and a name resemblance to any politician is NOT a finding. All transliterated firm names from the legacy-font registers were confirmed against MCA where a match was found; unmatched ones are flagged.

electoral_bonds.result: NEGATIVE for all municipal road firms above
electoral_bonds.detail: None of these AMC road-resurfacing firms appears in the SC/SBI electoral-bond purchaser disclosure (Mar-2024). The 'Apex Protech' bond hit a search engine returned was APCO Infratech (Lucknow), a DIFFERENT company. The bond data is dominated by large national firms (>=Rs 1 cr bonds: IRB/Modern Road Makers, MEIL, etc.); municipal-scale contractors are below that floor. ANALYTICAL POINT: local-contractor->party money does not flow through electoral bonds; it runs through channels bonds do not capture (local party funds, corporator/relative interests, cash).

director_to_bjp_office.detail: Cross-referenced the 7 confirmed firm directors against the full AMC councillor roster for BOTH the 2021-26 term (from wards.geojson) and the 2026-27 term (ViewFile ID 2638, 160 BJP councillors). NO firm director is a sitting councillor in either term. The surname 'Chaudhary' appears on 2 councillors (Naitiben Ashinbhai Chaudhary; Vinodkumar Sureshkumar Chaudhary) in both terms, but NEITHER is Laljibhai Godadbhai Chaudhary (the L.G. Chaudhary partner) — coincidence, not a person match. 'Kanani' (Vimal) and 'Parikh' (RKC) return zero. Directors are common Gujarati business-community surnames; resemblance is not evidence. UNCLOSED theoretical routes (heavy, low-yield, defamation-fraught): director-as-RELATIVE-of-councillor (needs per-councillor affidavit relative declarations), unelected party office (no roster), the 2017-21 term roster (not pulled; 2021-26 negative lowers its priority).

linkage_test_results.honest_conclusion: The STRUCTURAL link is real and tier-A: a BJP standing committee awards ~Rs 1,000 cr/yr of road work to a stable, zone-partitioned set of Gujarat firms. The FIRM-LEVEL political link is, on the cleanest public evidence (electoral bonds), NOT present, and no director->BJP-office tie was found. If a firm-level link exists it runs through local channels that require the corporator-affidavit cross-ref to test. Until then: report the carve-up + the BJP-approval structure as fact; do NOT label any firm 'BJP contractor'.
